title: 9una Optimized
description: FPS Modpack to unlock the best performence possible
body: 9una Optimized is a performance-focused Minecraft modpack designed to deliver smoother gameplay, faster load times, and higher FPS — all without sacrificing the vanilla feel. It carefully combines optimization mods, improved rendering, and memory management tweaks to give players a clean, stable, and efficient experience. Whether you're exploring vast worlds or building massive projects, 9una Optimized ensures your game runs at its best.
